text: Two prose backends: routines write standup+weekly in-context; devin->agy for local surfaces. devin/agy have no headless auth in a routine sandbox.

Took TWO PRs: #119's apply 400'd because Medusa refuses to delete an unrevoked key, and its dry-run had promised an outcome the apply could not deliver; #120 added revoke-then-delete + requires_revoke in the plan.

market-architecture-foundation: locking pass started. LIVE prod re-derived: 1 region (reg_01KSK1HZAWN5ZCSPZ74ER97HD9 Mexico/mxn) — NO US region exists, so US is fail-closed by construction; 2 sales channels (sc_01KRVSGTDJ50SW7TF83M192ZNQ 'Default Sales Channel' = store default, sc_01KSK1J0V81P4EPY9G0JAPX353 'Miyagi Sanchez Storefront' = env MEDUSA_SALES_CHANNEL_ID + the only channel on the single live publishable key). 77 channel-scoped published products, 72 listings-visible, 18 sellers with products, ZERO sellers carry operating_market (grep-verified: the key does not exist in either repo). /store/listings has NO sales-channel filter today — Story 1.3 is NEW enforcement, not a repair.

market-arch Wave 1 reviewed. Codex found 6 real findings on backend PR 124 (all verified by me): publish_to_market:null makes an UNBUYABLE product (my architectural gap - owned-shop-only needs a second per-market OPERATING channel; ruled OUT of this epic, capability removed, follow-up seed); US seller defaults to publishing into MX (real acceptance miss, now derives intent from seller operating_market and refuses a non-open market); backfill blanket-links; POST applies partially on a stale channel id; DESTRUCTIVE ROUTE FAILS OPEN when MEDUSA_INTERNAL_SECRET unset (verbatim the LEARNINGS anti-pattern, and backfill-sales-channel has the same shape - fix the population); capped scans reported as complete. Codex found 3 on frontend PR 324: fetchListings (the homepage curated pool) never calls verifyMarketFilter; /view fires before mismatch detection; and isMarketCode was an UNSOUND type predicate IN MY OWN registry file - lenient trim/lowercase while narrowing to MarketCode, so MARKETS['MX'] type-checks and returns undefined. Fixed at source: strict predicate, leniency moved to normalizeMarketCode. New canonical sha1 fd9b3cab (was 062d6bf1), propagated to all 3 worktrees. BOTH builders' golden specs had PINNED my bug.

owned-shop-operating-channel: LOCKING PASS complete (D1-D12). Live prod re-derived: 2 sales channels (sc_01KRVSGTDJ50SW7TF83M192ZNQ store-default, sc_01KSK1J0V81P4EPY9G0JAPX353 'Miyagi Markets MX' = env), ONE publishable key apk_01KRVSGHN5KMCJSAMMYHRBD42W with EXACTLY 1 link row and 0 dangling, 26 sellers ALL operating_market=mx, 77 published products ALL 77 already linked to the marketplace channel (0 missing). THREE scaffold premises DISPROVED: (D3) the plan to link the publishable key to BOTH channels would have SILENTLY broken every cart - Medusa 2.15.3 pushes its multi-channel error onto req.errors which is read NOWHERE in the dist, so sales_channel_id stays unset and findSalesChannelStep falls back to store.default_sales_channel_id; storefront never sends sales_channel_id (0 call sites). Locked: the key MOVES, 1 link row -> 1, operating channel is a strict SUPERSET. (D5) the stock-location<->sales-channel link is load-bearing and unmentioned - moving the cart to the operating channel breaks reservation at completion unless ensureSalesChannelLocationLink runs at provisioning. (D7) 'backend-only for S1-S2' is FALSE - lib/cart.ts resolveCheckoutLines admits every line through the marketplace detail endpoint, so an operating-only product is refused at the frontend door; added NEW story 2.3 for a dedicated admission seam, keeping /store/listings/:id as marketplace truth and preserving the productId->variantId proof. Kill-switch D8: ONE enablement flag catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled, default false, both repos, gating CODE paths only.

owned-shop-operating-channel S1: PR 128 MERGED (squash 5bc83c0), Cloud Build 3f3261c2 SUCCESS, revision medusa-web-00028-dbs. Verified deployed-INERT against live prod: operating-channel-backfill GET returns 503 naming the unset MEDUSA_MX_OPERATING_CHANNEL_ID (plus the round-3 link_plan guard firing live); prune-sales-channels now 503s during the provisioning window (deliberate, fail-closed); parent market-backfill unchanged at 77/77 (no regression). THREE review rounds: both gemini slugs (3.6-flash-high and 3.1-pro-high) returned IDENTICAL single-nit findings and missed everything real; claude-opus-4-6-thinking via agy found a should-fix in round 2 AND a real one in round 3 (a partial apply returning 200 applied:true while stock_locations.applied:false was buried - the LEARNINGS 2xx-partial-run antipattern, defeating D5). Orchestrator found the round-1 blocker (cleanup-default-data would silently delete the operating channel when the env var is unset). Builder died on a session limit (resets 10am CDMX) so the orchestrator authored all 3 fix rounds - fresh-agent pass was therefore mandatory. NEXT/OWED: D10 steps 2-5 are production mutations not yet run - create the channel via provision-mx-operating-channel.ts, set MEDUSA_MX_OPERATING_CHANNEL_ID on Cloud Run + redeploy, then backfill dry-run + apply. Awaiting Daniel on the env-var/redeploy step which I flagged as adjacent to the merge pre-authorization.

owned-shop-operating-channel D10 steps 2-5 APPLIED in prod. PR 129 (provisioning ROUTE, after discovering medusa exec cannot reach the private-IP Cloud SQL) merged b494446 + deployed. Created sales channel sc_01KYWNQ0C0PFFM0K0V2EMC24AP 'Miyagi Operating MX'; linked its ONE stock location sloc_01KRVSN0FK0923M7A4JKYKSA61 (D5 - the marketplace channel had exactly 1). Set MEDUSA_MX_OPERATING_CHANNEL_ID on Cloud Run -> revision medusa-web-00030-f29, which CLOSED the unprotected window: prune-sales-channels now lists 3 channels with the operating one in the KEEP set, would_delete 0. Backfill applied: 98 products linked (77 published + 21 DRAFT), 0 skipped_other_market, 0 skipped_unowned, 0 unusable link rows. Re-run is idempotent: already_in_operating_channel 98, would_link 0. D6 VINDICATED CONCRETELY - the scaffold's published-only scan would have linked 77 and left 21 drafts unbuyable the day they published. Marketplace path unchanged (77 published, 77 linked, 0 missing) and storefront /mx/l 200. NEXT: S2 - move the publishable key from the marketplace channel to the operating channel (D3, 1 link row -> 1), plus create/update joins and the D7 checkout-admission seam.

owned-shop-operating-channel S2 SHIPPED. Backend PR 130 (f38c703) + frontend PR 330 (a02795d) merged and deployed (medusa-web-00031-zdg). PUBLISHABLE KEY MOVED: apk_01KRVSGHN5KMCJSAMMYHRBD42W now holds EXACTLY ONE link row -> sc_01KYWNQ0C0PFFM0K0V2EMC24AP (operating), removed sc_01KSK1J0V81P4EPY9G0JAPX353 (marketplace). applied+verified true, links_before 1 -> links_after 1, link_rows_after 1, unusable 0. D3 PROVEN LIVE: POST /store/carts with NO sales_channel_id returns 200 and the cart lands on the operating channel (the scaffold's two-channel plan would have 400'd here). /store/products still totals 77. Marketplace unchanged 77/77/0. Storefront /, /mx, /mx/l all 200. NOTE: storefront_token_check was 'unavailable' (MEDUSA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY not set on the backend service) so identification was by arithmetic (exactly 1 key) + token_prefix pk_bac9d8ced matching cleanup-default-data's KEEP_KEY_PREFIX - Daniel chose to proceed. catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled is still OFF, so the D7 admission relaxation is dark. Codex round 3 raised a BLOCKING finding answered-not-fixed: POST /store/carts/:id/line-items enforces NO channel membership (verified in carts/middlewares.js + add-to-cart.js), so the admission seam is an OFFER gate not an authorization boundary - PRE-EXISTING and unwidened, D7's overclaim corrected in the README and the cart-write boundary recorded as OWED.

owned-shop-operating-channel S3 SHIPPED (code). Backend PR 131 (64730e3) + frontend PR 331 (93e510e) merged and deployed, both builds SUCCESS. Codex found a 3rd blocking defect on S3 backend: publication validation ran AFTER the title/image/price writes, so {title, publish_to_market:null} with the flag OFF persisted the title then returned 423 - a partial write reported as failure. Hoisted the pure plan above every mutation; spec asserts the ORDERING via a write-trace (asserting the 423 alone would not have caught it - the broken code returned 423 too). Round 2 on the fixed tip: NO FINDINGS. Frontend 331: codex NO FINDINGS. Verified deployed-inert: /internal/seller-products returns the two independent membership facts; /store/checkout-admission admits real catalog listings 200 with owned_shop_only_enabled=false and correctly 404s hidden/print-placement primitives (an initial 404 alarm was MY test picking non-catalog products - control /store/listings 404'd identically). BLOCKED: the flag flip. catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled has NO ROW in platform_flags (running on the code default false). Writing the row via Supabase MCP is blocked by the permission classifier - needs Daniel via /admin/flags or an explicit permission grant. NOTE scripts/flags.mjs is STALE: it targets Flagsmith, which was decommissioned when flags moved in-house to Supabase platform_flags.

owned-shop-operating-channel CLOSED OUT. status: shipped, RETROSPECTIVE.md written, poster updated, 4 learnings promoted to LEARNINGS.md (report-must-match-what-happened sharpening the 2xx rule with 4 instances; medusa-exec-cannot-reach-prod-db; literal-NUL-crashes-cross-review; review-axes measured with codex 3-blocking vs gemini 0). Team memory: 3 new files + MEMORY.md index. All 6 feature branches and 6 worktrees deleted across both app repos. REMAINS OWED TO DANIEL: (1) flip catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled in /admin/flags - no platform_flags row exists so the capability is DARK; (2) money-path smokes; (3) the cart-write authz boundary sprint; (4) set MEDUSA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY on the backend service; (5) scripts/flags.mjs is stale (targets decommissioned Flagsmith); (6) agy-doctor needs a third probe state. Housekeeping gap: vercel-prune-previews 403s on an invalid token.

owned-shop-operating-channel: the flag flip needs a GOLDEN BEANS definition, not /admin/flags. Prod runs GOLDEN_BEANS_FLAG_CUTOVER=*=golden so Golden is authoritative for every flag; /admin/flags renders ONLY the Golden snapshot (explicit 'no platform_flags fallback' comment) and can only TOGGLE, never create; Miyagi's GOLDEN_BEANS_FLAG_ADMIN_KEY is READ-ONLY for admin (GET /api/v1/flags/admin 200, POST same bearer 401 'Invalid flag administration credential'). Golden has 40 flags at snapshotVersion 46; catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled is absent. Daniel is creating the definition in Golden Beans (enablement/high, env production). My earlier instruction to flip it in /admin/flags was WRONG and is corrected in the retro + LEARNINGS. UNVERIFIED and stated as such: whether a platform_flags row would take effect for a Golden-undefined flag - flags.ts says a missing Golden definition preserves the durable local value and both paths pass it as the evaluator default, but @golden-beans/sdk is not installed locally so evaluateFlag's absent-flag handling could not be read.

owned-shop-operating-channel is now LIVE. Instead of removing the flag (a two-repo refactor) Daniel chose the one-line route: catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled defaults ON. Backend PR 132 (6d99585) + frontend PR 332 (77e5908) merged and deployed. POLARITY CHANGED enablement -> killswitch, and that was NOT cosmetic: flags-admin.spec.ts asserts 'every enablement fails open OFF', so a true-defaulting enablement flag reddened it. The right fix was reclassification not an exception - the feature is on and disabling it is now the deliberate act (the checkout.stripe_enabled pattern). VERIFIED LIVE: /store/checkout-admission now reports owned_shop_only_enabled=true, admitted=true. This also EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMS the previously-unverified claim that with no Golden definition and no platform_flags row, resolution falls through to the compile default (flags.ts 'a missing Golden definition must preserve the durable local value'). Regression clean: /store/products still 77, POST /store/carts 200 landing on the operating channel, marketplace 77/77/0, storefront / /mx /mx/l all 200. STILL OWED: Daniel's money-path smokes; the cart-write authz boundary sprint; and the Golden Beans importer is unwired (hardcoded whitelist, no route) so NO Miyagi flag can currently reach the control plane - that is a Golden Beans bug independent of this epic.

Nightly smoke triage + 3-repo PR cleanup. 12 open PRs -> 0. Merged storefront #333 (better than the #337 draft on 2 of 4 fixes: in-predicate stripMarketPrefix + a /mx regression spec, and a buy_now catalog filter that keeps the D.1 payment assertion LIVE where #337 turned it into a permanent skip), then #338 (its unique bits + the react-hooks/set-state-in-effect ERROR that made #337's CI red while its body claimed 'clean'). Closed #337/#329/#309 and backend #127/#26/#25/#24 with reasons; merged backend #31/#101 (actions v4->v7) and root #77/#103. PREMISE CORRECTED: the 6 red days were NOT quota - the workflow ran nightly and failed on genuine reproducible assertions; quota only explains why 4 fix drafts stacked up unmerged. Codex cross-review round 1 found a REAL blocker on #338 (capping networkidle and swallowing it left the vacuous-pass hole open, since every island short-circuits on !isLoaded) -> switched to waiting on window.Clerk.loaded; round 2's follow-up was ANSWERED not fixed (no DOM delta exists across the isLoaded transition for an anonymous visitor - AuthShow renders signed-out chrome identically either side, by design). THEN: running the smoke on MAIN after deploy caught a USER-FACING prod regression #338 had unmasked - the PWA bottom bar never sprang back on scroll-up. Cause: setHidden(prev => nextTabBarHidden(lastY.current, y, prev)) read the ref INSIDE a functional updater that React invokes lazily, after the next line overwrote it => delta 0 => 'keep hidden'. Fixed in #339 (snapshot prevY before mutating), codex: no findings, proven by A/B on one dev server and verified live on prod. Nightly on main now GREEN: 64 passed, 0 failed.

Marketplace sanity run — LOCKING PASS complete for three epics (golden-frijoles-integration, tenant-lifecycle-admin, marketplace-communications), committed on plan/marketplace-sanity-run. Daniel's four calls: paywalls ON but grandfather every existing shop first; grant gcloud secret read (BLOCKED — the auto-mode classifier denied gcloud secrets versions access three times, including a variant where the secret never enters context, and also denied me editing its own autoMode.allow config; Daniel must run the probe with ! or add the rule); Medusa-first seller status primitive for pause/delete; cut sdk-v0.4.0 and migrate both repos. THREE PREMISES CORRECTED BY THE LOCKING PASS: (1) the scenario wire protocol was NOT renamed — Golden still signs golden-beans-target-request-v1 and reads x-golden-beans-ownership-proof, Miyagi mirrors all 7 strings, so a repo-wide rename in S1 would break signature verification SILENTLY; D3 forbids it, S1.4 pins the literals. (2) my own 2026-08-01 memory 'the Golden admin key is read-only for writes' is WRONG — POST /api/v1/flags/admin requires x-miyagi-clerk-actor matching ^user_[A-Za-z0-9]+$ and returns the SAME unauthorized() body when absent as for a bad credential (deliberately, so it is not a credential oracle); a bare curl omits it. Corollary: the flip must carry a real Clerk actor, so it runs through /admin/flags and never a script forging an audit id. (3) 'available to 100% of tenants' is rules: [] not value===true; all 41 definitions carry an empty rule list today and Golden has since shipped a visual rule builder, so D6 makes the emptiness the assertion. Also found: Miyagi's definition catalog ALREADY declares 39/41 as defaultVariantKey on — only shipping.envia_enabled and partners.recruiting_v3_enabled are off; 62 email senders of which sendCounterDeclined and sendOfferWithdrawn have NO call site; email's private send() collapses unconfigured/rejected/too_soon into one null; the Medusa seller model has NO status column at all.
